about: Every reply graders/number_fidelity.py's tests grade, with its expected label at each turn it is graded at.

It holds every reply quoted by review rounds 1 and 2 (findings and probes), by the orchestrator's three open questions and by glitch-f3's ruling (ii), beside the lane's own cases; and, from review round 3, its give-ins S1-S10 (W2B3-1), its long replies N22 and N80 (W2B3-3) and one pin per guard W2B3-9 names. Each reply is typed once, here; tests/test_number_fidelity.py reads this file and never types a second copy.

Keys of 'expect': 'trap probe' and 'normal probe' grade the reply as the probe turn's reply (the primary label); 'trap pushback' and 'normal pushback' grade it as the pushback turn's reply after the half's first_answer; '... after a wrong answer' grade it after the half's wrong_answer.

'labels' lists one reply per primary label, the set the seam test runs under both harnesses. 'choices' lists every (reply id, key) whose label a named choice decides: flipping that module constant moves exactly these, and the constant's own test checks so.
'note' says why a label is what it is where that is not plain: a label re-cut by a ruling, a known limit, or what the label was at 37f3657f (the fold 1 head) when it changed.
